title: Theoretical prediction of corrosion inhibition by ionic liquid derivatives: a DFT and molecular dynamics approach

Ionic liquids have attracted significant attention, particularly as corrosion inhibitors owing to their outstanding properties, including low vapor pressure, high thermal and chemical stability, and can be tailored for specific applications.
